tools.name: nh_inspect
tools.description: Read-only view of the live notebook and kernel. view: status (connection, kernel, hooks), overview (outline + variables, default), outline (cells with ids, titles, run status, STALE and edited flags), vars (variables with shapes, dtypes, nulls), var (one variable; rows <= 20 of its head), cell (one cell's source, intent and outputs; returns its sha for nh_edit_cell), intents (why each nh cell exists). Call it before your first write in a session. Never Read .ipynb files.

view.description: status | overview | outline | vars | var | cell | intents

cell_id.description: Cell id for view='cell', or to center the outline.

rows.description: Rows of a dataframe head for view='var' (default [inspect].head_rows, max 20).

notebook.description: Notebook path relative to the project. Default: the active notebook.

tools.name: nh_add_cell
tools.description: Insert ONE code cell with a note above it (### title <= 8 words + 2-5 bullets: what the cell does and why) and run it now in the user's kernel. Once per user message. Pass title and notes as plain text without '#' or '-'. intent = the user's ask in one line. code: plain, readable Python; no '# %%' separators, no package installs, no markdown output. Returns the real output, a before/after self-check and readability hints.

title.description: What the cell does, at most 8 words, plain text.

notes.description: 2-5 plain bullets: what the cell does and why.

intent.description: The user's ask in one line.

after_cell_id.description: Insert after this cell. Default: at the bottom.

notebook.description: Notebook path relative to the project. Default: the active notebook.

tools.name: nh_edit_cell
tools.description: Replace the code of ONE existing cell and run it. Use it when the user asks to change a specific cell (this is the message's one cell), or to fix the cell you wrote this message after it failed (at most 2 retries). Pass base_sha from nh_inspect(view='cell') when editing a cell you did not just write. title/notes update the note above nh's own cells; human cells never get a note.

code.description: The new code for the whole cell.

base_sha.description: sha from nh_inspect(view='cell') for cells you did not just write.

intent.description: The user's ask in one line (required if the cell has none).

notebook.description: Notebook path relative to the project. Default: the active notebook.

tools.name: nh_run
tools.description: mode='run' re-runs one existing cell unchanged; it counts as the message's one action, so only do it when the user asks. mode='wait' waits up to about 100 s more for a cell reported as RUNNING. mode='interrupt' stops a running nh cell (only after it has started).

cell_id.description: The cell to run, wait for, or interrupt.

notebook.description: Notebook path relative to the project. Default: the active notebook.

tools.name: nh_undo
tools.description: Undo nh's last change: removes a cell nh added (with its note) or restores the code from before nh's edit. Kernel variables are NOT rolled back; the result says which ones still hold undone results. Later cells that used them are marked outdated. Refuses if the user edited the cell since; pass force=true only after they confirm.

cell_id.description: The cell to undo. Default: nh's last change.

force.description: Only after the user confirms overwriting their own edits.

notebook.description: Notebook path relative to the project. Default: the active notebook.
